byte_definitions.logical_bundle: all referenced file lengths at final revision
byte_definitions.payload: submitted metadata plus new objects, not wire bytes

gpu_measurement_scope: CUDA stream elapsed during measured updates/analysis only; excludes unmeasured semantic-event GPU work

prior_analysis.byte_scope: completed requested file payload; resumed bytes and CLI log excluded; wire bytes NOT_MEASURED

training.byte_scope: completed requested file payload; resumed bytes and CLI log excluded; wire bytes NOT_MEASURED

kaggle_saved_output_bytes.reason: Only known after Kaggle retains the version

mandatory_event_cost.reason: NOT_RECORDED; oracle_seconds is not the complete event cost

model_and_probe_restore_scope: Frozen engine combines model/Probe restore; separate Probe-only cost NOT_MEASURED

observed_update_plus_analysis_cuda_secon.source: training update + posthoc CUDA stream measurements (partial resource scope)

posthoc_gpu_scope: verified COMPLETE task compute only; failed-task GPU time is NOT_RECORDED
posthoc_session_wall_scope: task-loop wall only; excludes initial download, aggregation and GitHub publication

private_cumulative_package_bytes.scope: private result payload/receipts/index; excludes public reports

remaining_cost_seconds.reason: Retryable PENDING/BLOCKED compute only; excludes unavailable assets, I/O and hardware variation
remaining_cost_seconds.source: coverage-ledger.json; stage/role observed medians with at least 3 tasks

serialization_scope: latest checkpoint only; not a sum over all serializations

total_study_cuda_resource_seconds.reason: Complete resource total unavailable: semantic-event GPU time not separately recorded
